name: redsocks
notes: Tracks the latest darkk/redsocks upstream commit checked 2026-11-19. Retained changes implement the shared C/JNI engine, CONNECT SNI, verified upstream TLS and embedded cntlm, public libevent 2.x APIs, minimum Android API/macOS portability, and regression-backed stream/lifecycle cleanup. cntlm is a separately pinned sibling dependency. See README.md and docs/embedding.md; upstream libraries are not patched at build time.
